cph-1.title: Arbejdende, arkæologisk værksted – gratis adgang
cph-1.summary: Watch archaeologists work with finds from excavations and ask questions.
cph-1.restrictions: Enter the workshop at Stormgade 20, separate from the main museum entrance at Stormgade 18.

cph-10.title: Frederik Smal: Common Silent Places
cph-10.summary: Minimalist drawings by Frederik Smal in the water tower.
cph-10.restrictions: Only confirmed exhibition access hours are included; do not apply concert schedules to the exhibition.

cph-103.title: Kreativt fællesskab for familier med børn (1-6 år)
cph-103.summary: Creative family activities with clay, painting and drawing.
cph-103.restrictions: Children aged 1–6 with adults. Places are limited; register using the contacts on the primary page. No session on 21 November.

cph-106.title: Åbent hus: Dissekér en fisk, mød en krabbe – og bliv klogere på livet i havet
cph-106.summary: An open day exploring fish and crabs through observation, anatomy and creative activities.
cph-106.restrictions: Free admission; hot drinks cost DKK 10. The 31 October entry is held because the text describes November although the calendar includes October.

cph-11.title: Folkekøkken i Union
cph-11.summary: A community dinner featuring dishes from different countries, with a vegetarian option.
cph-11.restrictions: Food is sold from 17:30 to 19:30; drinks are extra. Adults DKK 90; children aged 3–12 DKK 35.

cph-113.title: Silent Book Club
cph-113.summary: Quiet shared reading with a brief introduction and exchange of recommendations.
cph-113.restrictions: Conversation is in English; bring a book in any language. No registration. Fiction section on the left on the first level.

cph-120.title: Gaudium: The Land of Dreams
cph-120.summary: Gaudium vocal ensemble presents The Land of Dreams.
cph-120.restrictions: Standard ticket DKK 130; students DKK 100. The tower is unheated: wear warm clothes. Two performances on 31 October, at 15:00 and 17:00.

cph-123.title: Stones in His Pockets
cph-123.summary: Two actors portray the residents of an Irish town in Stones in His Pockets.
cph-123.restrictions: Ages 15+. Two hours including an interval. Doors open 30 minutes before the performance. Listed ticket range DKK 40–235; availability of individual rates was not checked.

cph-127.title: Isdisco
cph-127.summary: An evening of ice skating with music.
cph-127.restrictions: Admission: over 16, DKK 50; under 16, DKK 30. The rate for exactly age 16 is not specified. Skate hire DKK 30. Helmet and gloves recommended; no food or drinks on the ice.

cph-131.title: For børn: Skriv et (rigtigt) brev
cph-131.summary: Children and adults write or draw letters for a shared archive.
cph-131.restrictions: Children aged 3–12 with an adult. Letters stay in the cultural centre's public archive and are not sent to recipients. Second floor; tidy up afterwards.
notes: Event omits street; matched official named-venue contact page to Valgårdsvej 4.

cph-135.title: Halfdans ABC med Teater AstaBasta
cph-135.summary: A musical puppet show based on Halfdans ABC.
cph-135.restrictions: For children aged 4 and up. About 40 minutes; free, no registration.

cph-138.title: lowkey: critical coding club
cph-138.summary: A self-organised lowkey gathering for people who write computer programs.
cph-138.restrictions: All experience levels. Read the organiser's Social Rules; bring your own project or laptop.

cph-14.title: Samtalesalon og forfatteraften med Caspar Eric
cph-14.summary: A literary conversation with poet Caspar Eric.

cph-142.title: Allehelgenskoncert med Karitas
cph-142.summary: An All Saints' Day concert by the Karitas choir.
cph-142.restrictions: Free, no registration; window area to the right of the main entrance.

cph-145.title: LindyHop Introklasser
cph-145.summary: An introductory Lindy Hop and Charleston class.
cph-145.restrictions: Free; no partner needed because participants change partners during the class.

cph-146.title: Sunday Swing
cph-146.restrictions: Free for members; seasonal membership costs DKK 60. Do not label this as unconditionally free for everyone.

cph-16.title: Bryggen Synger Sammen
cph-16.summary: Group singing with a host and pianist.
cph-16.restrictions: Free. The dates 28 October and 25 November are separately confirmed; not a weekly event.

cph-17.title: Manu Louis + Dc!
cph-17.summary: An electronic and experimental concert by Manu Louis with support from Dc!.
cph-17.restrictions: Advance tickets DKK 100; door tickets DKK 120. The listed interval is for the event, not individual artist stage times.

cph-18.title: Paradise Jazz: Dino Slow Flow
cph-18.summary: Jakob Dinesen's Slow Flow jazz project.
cph-18.restrictions: DKK 175. Doors open 30 minutes before the start. Held at BRØK, not HUSET, which is closed for renovation.

cph-2.title: Åbent værksted
cph-2.summary: An open workshop for digital fabrication, woodwork and small constructions.
cph-2.restrictions: No booking; help is available for beginners. Free consumable materials are not promised.

cph-25.title: Legestue mandag og torsdag
cph-25.summary: A self-directed playgroup for children and adults.
cph-25.restrictions: Children aged 0–4 with adults; no staff or registration. Obtain the room code from the first-floor office. Tidy up afterwards. Monday entries are held because end times conflict.

cph-26.title: Open Lab - Torsdag
cph-26.summary: An open technology workshop at Fablab.
cph-26.restrictions: Ask the superusers before using unfamiliar equipment. Located at Julius Andersens Vej 1, not the former Valby Kulturhus address.

cph-44.title: Torsdagscafé i Osramhuset
cph-44.summary: A café with board games, creative activities and children's toys.
cph-44.restrictions: Free entry; food and drinks are not advertised as free. Osramhuset's small hall.

cph-5.title: Åben Onsdag
cph-5.summary: Open workshops for sewing, printing, drawing and making things.
cph-5.restrictions: Fourth floor of Valby Kulturhus; free entry, materials charged separately.

cph-7.title: Undringstime og fællesspisning med Rethinking Economics
cph-7.summary: A discussion of economics and environmental change, followed by a shared dinner.
cph-7.restrictions: Ticket DKK 50. No prior knowledge of economics required.

cph-72.title: Calum Builder: (Re)Constructed Organ & Voices
cph-72.summary: Calum Builder's organ made from recycled pipes with a vocal ensemble.
cph-72.restrictions: DKK 80 at the door. 19:30 is the door-opening time; the exact music start is not separated from the overall event interval.
notes: 19:30 is doors-open time; not a separately verified performance start.

cph-79.title: Skriveworkshop: Tegnet litteratur
cph-79.summary: A drawn-literature workshop with Simon Bukhave.
cph-79.restrictions: For adults; free registration required. Bring paper and a pen or a laptop; table space is limited. The mirror's 30 October date is excluded; the primary page gives 12 November as the next date.

cph-8.title: Kortspil i Kraftwerket
cph-8.summary: A gathering to play collectible card games.
cph-8.restrictions: Membership is not required; optional club membership costs DKK 20 per year.

cph-81.title: Fredags modellering, tegning og maling
cph-81.summary: Drawing, painting or modelling with a live model.
cph-81.restrictions: DKK 80. Bring your own materials and paper; clay is sold separately. This is practice, not a full course. Break from 12:30 to 13:00.

cph-90.title: Dobbeltkoncert: Det Bliver Mellem Os og Nikolaj Paakjær.
cph-90.summary: A double concert by Det Bliver Mellem Os and Nikolaj Paakjær.
cph-90.restrictions: Student ticket DKK 65; standard ticket DKK 110.

cph-93.title: Enjoy the Silence
cph-93.summary: A Depeche Mode tribute performed by Enjoy the Silence.
cph-93.restrictions: Advance tickets DKK 225 plus fee; door tickets DKK 275. Doors at 19:30, music at 20:00.

cph-96.title: Tangospirer presents: Milonga Firefly
cph-96.summary: Milonga Firefly tango evening with an introductory class.
cph-96.restrictions: Entry from 20:00; class at 20:15, social dancing at 21:15. No partner needed. Members DKK 40; non-members DKK 80. Pay by MobilePay at the door.

cph-99.title: Åben hal i Korsgadehallen
cph-99.summary: Ball games, movement and free play in a sports hall.
cph-99.restrictions: Children aged 2–8 with adults; free, no registration.

cph-L18.title: RÆSON: Menneskets vilkår i klimakrisens tid. Forfattersamtale med Nikolaj Schultz
cph-L18.summary: A conversation with Nikolaj Schultz about human life and the climate crisis.
cph-L18.restrictions: A free ticket is required. Seats are not reserved; some have restricted visibility.

cph-L26.title: Bakteriers hemmelige kommunikation
cph-L26.summary: A popular-science lecture about communication between bacteria.
cph-L26.restrictions: Free; registration through Billetto required. Tingbjerg Library/Cultural Centre hall.

cph-L36.title: Open Lab - Tirsdag
cph-L36.restrictions: Ask the superusers before using unfamiliar equipment. Not at the former Valby Kulturhus address.

cph-L39.title: Krea og håndarbejde med Tirsdagsklubben
cph-L39.summary: A creative club for knitting, drawing and other crafts.
cph-L39.restrictions: Bring your own materials and project. Contact the club using the details on the primary page to take part.

cph-L4.title: Skriveworkshop: Bryd rammerne med erasure poesi
cph-L4.summary: An erasure-poetry workshop with Deniz Kiy.
cph-L4.restrictions: For adults; no experience required. Source texts are in English; free registration is mandatory. Bring materials or a laptop; table space is limited.

cph-L40.title: Mit barns første rytme
cph-L40.summary: A gathering for parents and babies about rhythm and music.
cph-L40.restrictions: Book a ticket in advance for one adult and a baby aged 2–12 months. Prams cannot be taken to the fourth floor; park them on the first level.

cph-L48.title: Syværkstedet i Vesterbro Bibliotek og Kulturhus
cph-L48.restrictions: No booking. Bring your project, fabric and preferably suitable thread. Room 3.2 Mogens, third floor, staircase 4 with lift access.

cph-L53.title: Genopdaget: Dea Trier Mørch med Pernille Ipsen og Johanne Mygind
cph-L53.summary: A discussion of Dea Trier Mørch with Pernille Ipsen and Johanne Mygind.
cph-L53.restrictions: Free admission and no reserved seats; the primary page also has a ticket link. Seating opens at 16:30; some seats have restricted visibility.
notes: Header has ticket link; body says no reserved seat tickets. Do not claim unconditional no-registration entry.

cph-L54.title: Fællesspisning tirsdag i FLOK
cph-L54.summary: A vegetarian community dinner at FLOK.
cph-L54.restrictions: Adults DKK 75; children aged 3–12 DKK 35. No booking. Food is served until 18:30; diners may stay until 19:00.

cph-L55.title: Con altre ord. Italiensk-dansk snakkeklub
cph-L55.summary: A conversation gathering in Italian and Danish.
cph-L55.restrictions: Not a language lesson; all levels welcome. Ten places; free registration is mandatory.

cph-L59.title: Fællesspisning med KraftWerkets Folkekøkken
cph-L59.summary: A vegan community dinner at KraftWerket.
cph-L59.restrictions: DKK 50. Doors open at 18:00; food starts at 18:30.

cph-L6.title: Fælleslæsning
cph-L6.restrictions: Free; just turn up. Downstairs meeting room at Valby Library.

cph-L62.title: Tysk Filmklub - Buddenbrooks
cph-L62.summary: A film-club screening of the 1923 silent film Buddenbrooks.
cph-L62.restrictions: English subtitles and a short introduction. Free; registration required.

cph-museum.title: Udstilling: HVA' HAR DU TRAVLT FOR?
cph-museum.summary: A photography exhibition about changes in Copenhagen's urban environment.
cph-museum.restrictions: Adults DKK 110; under-18s free. Detailed hours from the text are used, not the card's generic 10:00–17:00 interval.
